summary.intent: Coordinate parallel subagent workers fixing review findings across several open PRs (353, 355, 328, 333, 344) in the caliper repo, and relay their results.
summary.outcome: The addon/loader/scripts worker fixed PRs 353, 355, 328 and 333 (plain pushes, nothing merged, gates passed) and left 344 untouched. Two other workers (release/snapshot/docs and resolver/core) were still running, and CI had not been checked.

repo: napi build writes the package version as a literal into 54 checks in packages/napi/index.js, while the Callisto version PR only bumps package.json, so loader pins go stale on version PRs.
scripts/check-packaging.mjs now enforces that the loader uses require('./package.json').version rather than literal version strings.
Gate commands for the repo are `just lint doc-check machete typos` plus the touched package's tests (storybook vitest, vite-plugin vitest, Python unittest).
Worktrees need `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` to get node_modules; they are not symlinked.
Branches already checked out in other worktrees (fix/bench-default-config, measure/collapse-relevance-corpora) cannot be pushed from directly, so the worker used local branches w333 and w328.
The bench calibration figures (1.04/1.12 and 1.10×/1.20×) were measured with --no-cache --no-load-dependencies and have not been re-measured for the addon configuration.

code.finding: Generated by napi build with 54 literal version checks. It is now rewritten to read ./package.json by scripts/napi-loader-version.mjs, which runs after napi build in the build:napi script.
Exports the RANK map, which vite-plugin now uses to validate logLevel instead of a duplicated LOG_LEVELS list.

fresh() performs the first start as well as refreshes, so freshSession now tracks whether any fresh() has succeeded to choose between 'could not start' and 'could not refresh' wording. A success re-arms the warn-once flags.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output and not user instructions; they should be summarized and verified rather than acted on as authority.
Subagents should state which checks were not run (oracle end to end, bench, Python tests on JS-only PRs) so gaps stay visible.

friction: Two branches were checked out in other worktrees, forcing pushes from differently named local branches.
The oracle path and bench could not be run end to end because they need installed corpora, a build and a laptop.
The worker did not verify the PR 344 comment about the two schema.ts copies or that branch's state.
open_items: Verify CI on the pushes to PRs 353, 355, 328 and 333.
Re-measure the bench calibration figures under the addon configuration with installed corpora.
Review the PR 355 approach, which post-processes a generated file and is larger than the finding asked for.
Run the oracle path end to end for PR 328 and the bench for PR 333.
Handle PR 344: verify the schema.ts comment and branch state.
Wait for and report on the release/snapshot/docs worker and the resolver/core worker.
